name: Phoebe Dean
source:
Phoebe, or better known as "Fame", exploded into popularity after winning the 15th season of Tournament of Ink. She also happens to be the stepsister of Wolves quarterback, [url=https://vndb.org/c148364]Blaine Fitzgerald[/url]. But it turns out [url=https://vndb.org/c148291]MC[/url] and Fame have a more obscure connection than her own stepbrother.

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/posts/move-chains-plot-70773805]Patreon[/url]]
